description: Move `downloads` (incl. `content` + `update` + `variant`) handlers/services — `DownloadService`, `DownloadHostingService`, `DownloadAuthorizer`, `AssetsService`, `SEOService` — into `scenarios/landing-page-business-suite/api/domain/downloads/` with exported `RegisterRoutes(router, deps)`.
